name: When should I address kitchen door frame damage instead of waiting?

mainEntity.name: When should I address kitchen door frame damage instead of waiting?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should schedule professional repair as soon as you notice the door sticking, latching improperly, or showing visible separation at the frame corners. In kitchens, signs like bubbling paint or soft wood near the floor indicate moisture intrusion that can spread to subflooring and adjacent cabinetry if left unaddressed. Prompt attention prevents minor hinge sag from cracking the entire jamb, and it avoids sudden failures where a pantry or exterior kitchen door refuses to close or lock securely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address damage as soon as the door sticks, fails to latch, or displays soft wood from moisture. Prompt repairs prevent further frame cracking and damage to nearby cabinets.
